Tara N.: Quick question  about carryover + year-end blackout. We hired a contractor (part-time) on 2025-12-15 who crossed the accrual cutoff and then the team had a company shutdown 12/29-01/02. Their accrual proration looks off and they hit the carryover soft cap. Can we make an exception?
Jordan (People Ops): Need specifics. Contractor ID and hire date + FTE please. Policy usually prorates for hire dates and prevents carryover above cap unless LOA/exception approved.
Tara N.: cid:67890, hire_date: 2025-12-15, FTE 0.5. They used 2 days PTO during the shutdown week (12/29-12/30) because they were told that week was mandatory off. System deducted full-day PTO for both days and then also applied year-end carryover cap on 12/31.
Eli (Payroll): That sounds like two problems: (1) accrual proration didn't account for mid-December hires, and (2) blackout auto-deductions for mandatory shutdown should not deduct PTO when headcount is offsite. We'll need manager approval to adjust balances.
Marco (Hiring Manager): Confirm I told them the shutdown was mandatory and that managers would cover those days. I approve restoring lost PTO and allowing carryover exception for this case.
Tara N.: Pasting sanitized HRIS export: hire_date=2025-12-15, cid=67890, days_deducted=2 on 2025-12-29 and 2025-12-30, carryover_cap_triggered=2025-12-31.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks. Eli, can payroll run an adjustment and note audit reason? We'll need to attach manager approval to the ticket. Also adding a policy tweak to clarify hires within last 2 weeks of year and mandatory shutdowns.
Eli (Payroll): Will run manual adjustment. Command I'll execute:
```bash
payroll_tools/adjust_timeoff --cid 67890 --restore 16h --reason "mid-dec hire + mandatory shutdown; manager approval Marco"
```
HRIS Bot: adjustment AJ-2026-789 queued by Eli at 2026-03-24T14:12:03Z
Eli (Payroll): Applied AJ-2026-789. PTO restored, carryover exception granted (up to 8h beyond soft cap). No retro tax impact expected. Logged audit note.
Jordan (People Ops): I'll update the time-off policy page: add bullet under "year-end carryover" -> "new hires in the two calendar weeks before year-end who are impacted by a mandatory company shutdown may be granted a one-time carryover exception with manager attestation." Also create manager how-to for exceptions.
Marco (Hiring Manager): Thanks all  they saw the corrected balance in the portal. I'll mention this in my onboarding notes so folks know.
Tara N.: Confirmed balance looks correct. Appreciate the fast help.
Jordan (People Ops): Closing thread and filing incident HR-2026-402 for audit and to track the policy update. If anyone sees similar proration edge-cases for other regions, please ping me directly.
